items.title: Expedia (NASDAQ:EXPE) Beats Expectations in Strong Q2 CY2026, Quarterly Revenue Guidance Slightly Exceeds Expectations
items.summary: Online travel agency Expedia (NASDAQ:EXPE) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 14% year on year to $4.32 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $4.70 billion at the midpoint, 0.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.76 per share was 9.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
